_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#8 — the structural time loop stops at whichever of NUMSTEP and MAXTIME is reached first, and the early stop is silent (exit 0, no warning). Same deck three ways: TIMESTEP 0.1 / NUMSTEP 100 / MAXTIME 0.3 runs 3 of the requested 100 steps and ends on 'Finalised step 3 / 100'; TIMESTEP 0.1 / NUMSTEP 3 / MAXTIME 100 ends on 'Finalised step 3 / 3'; MAXTIME 0 executes the loop body zero times, prints no step line at all, and still exits 0. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf). MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): MAXTIME 0.3 becomes 10.0 and MAXTIME 0 becomes 0.5. 'maxtime_clips: EXIT=0 STEPS_RUN=3', 'Finalised step 3 / 100' and 'maxtime_zero: EXIT=0 STEPS_RUN=0' all disappear, and the forbidden 'Finalised step 100 / 100' appears. Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: MAXTIME stops being the binding constraint. The clipping arm gets MAXTIME 10.0 and runs all 100 requested steps, the zero arm gets MAXTIME 0.5 and runs its 5, so the truncation the fixture exists to show does not happen and it must go red.
